programs.name: Statistics
programs.source:
*** Statistics.pgm 
*** This program demonstrates some of the commands in Analysis

ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" REPLACE
TYPEOUT "The first step in Analysis is to READ data." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Oswego
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
TYPEOUT "The next few commands perform simple analyses such as a line LISTing, FREQuency, and TABLES." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
LIST * 
FREQ  ILL
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:AgeWithCount
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
FREQ  Age WEIGHTVAR=[Count]
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:EvansCounty
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
TABLES CAT CHD
TABLES CAT CHD STRATAVAR=AGEG1
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Oswego
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
TYPEOUT "The MEANS command can be used with one or more variables." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
MEANS AGE ILL
*******************************
****  ADVANCED STATISTICS  ****
*******************************
**** >>Linear Regression -- the REGRESS command<<*
TYPEOUT "Simple linear regression using the REGRESS command. REGRESS Birthweight = Estriol"
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:EstriolAndBirthweight
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
REGRESS Birthweight = Estriol
DIALOG "The next command produces an XY scatter graph of the estriol and birthweight data. After you view the graph, close the Epi Graph window to continue the program." TITLETEXT="Close Epi Graph after viewing."
GRAPH Estriol Birthweight GRAPHTYPE="Scatter XY" TITLETEXT="Estriol and Birthweight" XTITLE="Estriol" YTITLE="Birthweight"
TYPEOUT "Next is an example of a command performing a multiple linear regression"
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:BabyBloodPressure
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
REGRESS SystolicBlood = AgeInDays Birthweight
TYPEOUT "Simple logistic regression using two variables." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
**** >>Logistic Regression -- the LOGISTIC command<<*
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:EvansCounty
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
LOGISTIC CHD = CAT
TYPEOUT "Determine if ECG modifies the CAT CHD relationship.   LOGISTIC CHD = CAT ECG CAT*ECG" TEXTFONT Blue  4 
LOGISTIC CHD = CAT ECG CAT*ECG
TYPEOUT "Use the Make Dummy button to create n-1 dummy variables.   LOGISTIC CHD = (AGEG2) CAT ECG"  TEXTFONT Blue  4 
LOGISTIC CHD = (AGEG2) CAT ECG
TYPEOUT "Conditional logistic regression for matched case-control data.   LOGISTIC CASE = RELY MATCHVAR = ID" TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Rely
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
LOGISTIC CASE = RELY MATCHVAR = ID
**** >> Complex Sample Frequencies <<*
TYPEOUT "Complex Sample Frequencies using the Expanded Program for Immunization (EPI) cluster survey." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Epi1
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
FREQ VAC PSUVAR=CLUSTER
TYPEOUT "Complex Sample Frequencies using a stratified cluster survey." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Epi10
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
FREQ  VAC STRATAVAR = LOCATION WEIGHTVAR=POPW PSUVAR=CLUSTER
**** >>Complex Sample Tables<<
TYPEOUT "Complex Sample Tables using a stratified cluster survey." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Epi10
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
TABLES PRENATAL VAC STRATAVAR=[LOCATION] WEIGHTVAR=POPW PSUVAR=CLUSTER
**** >>Complex Sample Means<<
TYPEOUT "Complex Sample Means using a stratified three-stage cluster survey needing sample weights." TEXTFONT Blue  4 
READ {Projects/Sample/Sample.prj}:Smoke
ROUTEOUT ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html" APPEND
MEANS NUMCIGAR STRATAVAR=[STRATA] WEIGHTVAR=SAMPW PSUVAR=PSUID
Dialog "Now the Execute Command will open the results written to the SampleStatisticsPGM.htm file in your default browser."
EXECUTE ".\Output\SampleStatisticsPGM.html"

forms.checkCode:
/*
Sample Surveillance System Check Code
This system and the Check Code contained here is for demonstration purposes only.
All names and places used in these sample data tables are fictional.
Any resemblence to actual persons or places is coincidental.
*/

/*  --------  COMMENTS  ---------
Multi-line comments are created using a slash-asterisk to begin the comment and 
an asterisk-slash to end the comment.  You can add comments to the Check Code
to describe what is happening, or comment out lines to prevent them from running. 
Simply wrap lines you want to comment with the slash-asterisk and asterisk-slash symbols.
*/

// Single lines can be commented by adding a double slash in the beginning of the line.

/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     DEFINED VARIABLES        XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Defined variables are used to hold calculated or assigned values in memory for use
in other sections of the Check Code.
*/

DefineVariables
	DEFINE EnteredDate DATEFORMAT
      DEFINE ReferenceDate DATEFORMAT
      DEFINE DateError YN
      DEFINE HighLightField YN
	DEFINE ZipError YN
	DEFINE ZipToTest TEXTINPUT
	DEFINE ZipAsNumeric NUMERIC 
End-DefineVariables

/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     SUB ROUTINES        XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Sub-routines are blocks of statements that can be called from 
several places in within the Check Code blocks.
*/

Sub DateERR_Future
	//This routine gives a simple dialog. 
	//It is called when a date is greater than the date of the computer.

	DIALOG "Date cannot be a future date." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"

End-Sub

Sub DateERR_EarlierThanDOB
	DIALOG "Date cannot be earlier than Birth Date. Please check both dates." TITLETEXT="Date Discrepancy"
End-Sub

Sub ValidateZip
	//This routine checks the format of the Zip Code field. 
	//In the United States, some postal zone codes (zip codes) begin with zeros.
	//Therefore, a Number field cannot be used nation-wide since Number fields do not store leading zeros.
      //Also, Zip codes must have at least 5 digits and are in the range from 00501 to 96999.
	//These business rules are enforced here.

      IF NOT ZipToTest = (.) THEN
             IF STRLEN( ZipToTest ) < 5 THEN
			ASSIGN ZipError = (+)
            	DIALOG "Zip Code requires 5 numbers to be valid. Please enter 5 numbers only." TITLETEXT="Invalid Zip Code"
             ELSE
                  ASSIGN ZipAsNumeric = TXTTONUM( ZipToTest )
			//Zip containing letters or symbols will return null from the TXTTONUM function.
                  IF NOT ZipAsNumeric = (.) THEN
	                  IF ZipAsNumeric < 501 OR ZipAsNumeric > 96999 THEN
					ASSIGN ZipError = (+)
            	            DIALOG "Valid U.S.P.S. zip codes are from 00501 to 96999." TITLETEXT="Zip Code out of range."
                  	ELSE
					ASSIGN ZipError = (-)
	                  END-IF
	             ELSE
				ASSIGN ZipError = (+)
				DIALOG "Zip code may contain invalid characters (letters or symbols). Please enter only numbers for the zip code." TITLETEXT="Invalid characters"
		       END-IF
             END-IF
       ELSE
		ASSIGN ZipError = (-)
       END-IF

End-Sub

/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     DATE VALIDATION     XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
*/

Sub GreaterThanReference
	//This routine simply compares the date being tested (EnteredDate) with a reference.
	//If the date being tested is greater than the reference date, 
	//   then the DateError flag is set to (+) which means Yes or True.

	//First, the DateError flag is set to (-) whinh means No or False.
      ASSIGN DateError = (-)

	//When this IF-THEN condition is True, it sets the DateError flag to True.
      If EnteredDate > ReferenceDate Then
            ASSIGN DateError = (+)
      End-If

End-Sub

Sub LessThanReference
      ASSIGN DateError = (-)
      IF EnteredDate < ReferenceDate Then
            ASSIGN DateError = (+)
      End-If
End-Sub

Sub CheckBirthDate
	//Most dates in this example system should not be before the date of birth of the patient.
	//This routine tests the date entered to make sure it is not less than Birth Date.

      If NOT Birthdate = (.) THEN
            ASSIGN ReferenceDate = BirthDate
            CALL LessThanReference
            If DateError Then
                  CALL DateERR_EarlierThanDOB
                  ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
            End-If
      End-If

End-Sub

Sub CheckSystemDate
	//Most dates in this example cannot occur in the future.
	//Therefore, this routine tests the date entered against the date of the system.
	//The SYSTEMDATE is a standard function in Epi Info 7 that returns the date of the 
	//computer's internal clock.

      ASSIGN ReferenceDate = SYSTEMDATE
      CALL GreaterThanReference
      If DateError Then
            CALL DateERR_Future
            ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
      End-If

End-Sub

Sub CheckDates
	//This routine simply calls other routines.  You can add routines similar to the ones above,
	//then call them here to have them check each date that needs to be validated.

      Call CheckBirthDate
      Call CheckSystemDate

End-Sub

/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     PAGE 1: PERSON     XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Adding page separators like this is optional, but it helps to locate blocks of code.  
Epi Info(tm)7 adds new command blocks to the very bottom. 
If you have time, you may want to cut and paste new blocks into the appropriate page sections
to keep the Check Code organized.
*/

/*
Most command blocks can have a Before section, an After section, or both. 
Some command blocks, such as those for CommandButtons, have a Click section.
Each section must have a starting and ending line. 
Commands within Before...End-Before are run before data entry occurs in that 
field, page, record, or form.
Commands within the After...End-After statements are run after data entry when the cursor leaves.
*/

Page Person
	//Code in this page block will run each time a page is displayed in the Enter tool.
	Before
		IF Sex="Female" THEN
 	           ENABLE Pregnant 
		ELSE
		     DISABLE Pregnant
		END
	End-Before
End-Page

Field EventDate
	After
            ASSIGN HighLightField = (-)
            ASSIGN EnteredDate = EventDate
            CALL CheckDates
		//The HighLightField flag is set to True within the CheckDates routine when
		//  there is a discrepancy with one of the date validation checks.
		If HighLightField Then
                  HIGHLIGHT EventDate
            Else
                  UNHIGHLIGHT EventDate
			ASSIGN Year=YEAR(EventDate)
			ASSIGN Week=EpiWeek(EventDate)
            End-If
      End-After
End-Field

Field LastName
	After
		IF Entered = (.) THEN
		    ASSIGN Entered = SYSTEMDATE
		END
	End-After
End-Field

Field FirstName
	After
		//The AUTOSEARCH command will identify if any of the search fields already exist
		//in the data tables. If no match is found, no dialog is displayed.
		//If a match is found, only the fields following the DISPLAYLIST keyword are shown in 
		//the Autosearch dialog.  Double-clicking a row in the dialog will discard any changes 
		//made in the current record and jump to the record clicked.  

		AUTOSEARCH FirstName LastName DISPLAYLIST LastName FirstName BirthDate CaseID Age

	End-After
End-Field

Field BirthDate
	After
	  IF NOT BirthDate = (.) THEN
	    ASSIGN HighLightField = (-)
	    ASSIGN EnteredDate = BirthDate
	    Call CheckSystemDate
	    IF HighLightField THEN
		  HIGHLIGHT BirthDate
	    ELSE
		IF NOT EventDate = (.) THEN
		  IF BirthDate > EventDate THEN
		    HIGHLIGHT BirthDate EventDate
		    DIALOG "Birth Date cannot be later than Event Date. Please check both dates." TITLETEXT="Date Discrepancy"
		  ELSE
		    UNHIGHLIGHT BirthDate EventDate
		    IF YEARS(BirthDate, EventDate) > 1 THEN
		       ASSIGN Age = YEARS(BirthDate, EventDate)
		       ASSIGN AgeType = "Years"
		    ELSE
		      IF MONTHS(BirthDate, EventDate) > 1 THEN
		     	  ASSIGN Age = MONTHS(BirthDate, EventDate)
			  ASSIGN AgeType = "Months"
		     	ELSE
		        IF DAYS(BirthDate, EventDate) > 1  THEN
		          ASSIGN Age = DAYS(BirthDate, EventDate)
		          ASSIGN AgeType = "Days"
		        ELSE
		          DIALOG "Please verify Event Date and Birth Date." TITLETEXT="Error in dates."
		        END-IF
		      END-IF
		    END-IF
		  END-IF
		END-IF
	    END-IF
	  END-IF
	End-After
End-Field

Field Sex
	After
		IF NOT Sex="Female" THEN
		     ASSIGN Pregnant=(-)	  
		     DISABLE Pregnant
		ELSE
 	           ENABLE Pregnant 
		END
	End-After
End-Field

Field ZipCode
	After
		ASSIGN ZipError = (-)
		ASSIGN ZipToTest = ZipCode
		CALL ValidateZip
		IF ZipError = (+) THEN
			HIGHLIGHT ZipCode
		ELSE
			UNHIGHLIGHT ZipCode
		END-IF
	End-After
End-Field

Field cmdCaseDefinitions
	Click
		EXECUTE WAITFOREXIT "http://www.cdc.gov/"
	End-Click
End-Field

Field SurveillanceDashboard
	Click
		EXECUTE WAITFOREXIT "AnalysisDashboard.exe .\Projects\Sample\SampleSurveillance.cvs7"
	End-Click
End-Field



/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     PAGE 2: HOSPITAL INFO   XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
*/

Page [Hospital Info]
	Before
		IF LabConfirmed = (-) THEN
			DISABLE LabDate Specimen
		ELSE
			ENABLE LabDate Specimen
		END-IF
		IF Hospitalized = (-) THEN
                  DISABLE DateAdmitted DateDischarged DoctorsName HospitalCity HospitalName
            ELSE
                  ENABLE DateAdmitted DateDischarged DoctorsName HospitalCity HospitalName
            END-IF
	End-Before
End-Page

Field Hospitalized
	After
		IF Hospitalized = (-) THEN
                  DISABLE DateAdmitted DateDischarged DoctorsName HospitalCity HospitalName
            ELSE
                  ENABLE DateAdmitted DateDischarged DoctorsName HospitalCity HospitalName
            END-IF
	End-After
End-Field

Field DateAdmitted
	After
            ASSIGN HighLightField = (-)
            ASSIGN EnteredDate = DateAdmitted
            CALL CheckDates
		IF HighLightField = (-) THEN
			If NOT EventDate = (.) Then
      	            ASSIGN ReferenceDate = EventDate
            	      CALL LessThanReference
                  	If DateError Then
                        	DIALOG "Date Admitted cannot be earlier than Event Date." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"
	                        ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
      	            End-If
			End-If
			IF HighLightField = (-) THEN
				If NOT DateDischarged = (.) Then
	            	      ASSIGN ReferenceDate = DateDischarged
      	            	CALL GreaterThanReference
	      	            If DateError Then
      	      	            DIALOG "Date Admitted cannot be later than Date Discharged." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"
            	      	      ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
	                  	End-If
				End-If
			End-If
		End-If
		If HighLightField Then
                  HIGHLIGHT DateAdmitted
            Else
                  UNHIGHLIGHT DateAdmitted
            End-If
	End-After
End-Field

Field DateDischarged
	After
            ASSIGN HighLightField = (-)
            ASSIGN EnteredDate = DateDischarged
            CALL CheckDates
		IF HighLightField = (-) THEN
			If NOT EventDate = (.) Then
      	            ASSIGN ReferenceDate = EventDate
            	      CALL LessThanReference
                  	If DateError Then
                        	DIALOG "Date Discharged cannot be earlier than Event Date." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"
	                        ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
      	            End-If
			End-If
			IF HighLightField = (-) THEN
				If NOT DateAdmitted = (.) Then
		                  ASSIGN ReferenceDate = DateAdmitted 
      		            CALL LessThanReference
            		      If DateError Then
                  		      DIALOG "Date Discharged cannot be earlier than Date Admitted." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"
                        		ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
		                  End-If
	                  End-If
			End-If
		End-If

		If HighLightField Then
                  HIGHLIGHT DateDischarged
            Else
                  UNHIGHLIGHT DateDischarged
            End-If
	End-After
End-Field

Field LabConfirmed
	After
		//add code here
		IF LabConfirmed = (-) THEN
			DISABLE LabDate Specimen
			CLEAR LabDate Specimen
		ELSE
			ENABLE LabDate Specimen
		END-IF
	End-After
End-Field

/*
XXXXXXXXXXX     PAGE 3: CASE REPORT    XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
*/

Page [Case Report]
	Before
		//This section illustrates three ways to compare values.
		//If the condition is true, the corresponding Relate button becomes enabled.
		//This method allows for conditionally related records to be collected.

		IF Disease LIKE "HEP*" THEN
			ENABLE Hepatitis
		ELSE
			DISABLE Hepatitis
		END-IF

		IF Disease ="LYME" THEN
			ENABLE Lyme
		ELSE
			DISABLE Lyme
		END-IF
		IF EVENTCODE="10150" OR EVENTCODE="10590" OR EVENTCODE="10650" OR EVENTCODE="10640" THEN
			ENABLE Meningitis
		ELSE
			DISABLE Meningitis
		END-IF
	End-Before
End-Page

Field ReportDate
	After
            ASSIGN HighLightField = (-)
            ASSIGN EnteredDate = ReportDate 
            CALL CheckDates
		If NOT (EventDate = (.) OR HighLightField) Then
                  ASSIGN ReferenceDate = EventDate
                  CALL LessThanReference
                  If DateError Then
                        DIALOG "Report date cannot be earlier than Event Date." TITLETEXT="Invalid Date"
                        ASSIGN HighLightField = (+)
                  End-If
		End-If
		If HighLightField Then
                  HIGHLIGHT ReportDate
            Else
                  UNHIGHLIGHT ReportDate
            End-If
	End-After
End-Field

Field Status
	After
		ASSIGN UPDATED=SYSTEMDATE
	End-After
End-Field
